## Behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For refactoring or tooling, explain
the concrete maintenance or verification benefit.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results, including skipped or unavailable
checks. Identify browser coverage and any live integration limits.

## Review and risk

For financial, persistence, trust-boundary, or verification changes, record
independent review and how findings were resolved. Call out intentional contract
or test changes, migrations, new prerequisites, and recovery implications.
